_: Themed cups, plates and napkins (2026-10-30, the owner: 'themed cup diye bir kategori', the same for plates and napkins). Each is drawn from words, never from a shop's photo, with no characters, logos or words; 'look' is how it is described to the render and the AI picture. scripts/table/themed-render.mjs makes the pieces; lib/studio/tableCatalog.ts offers them in their themes.
